source: NEXT_GENERATION_ASSIGNMENT_ENGINE.md — §8.10 (Parameter register for the cost function)
note: §8.10 states Parameter, Unit, Default, Class, and Source of truth. It states no Range and no Scope column, so `range` and `scopes` here are implementation-assigned: ranges are the widest bounds that keep the term well-formed (an exchange rate is non-negative; a bounded multiplier is finite), and scopes follow the parameter's own index — `[agent_class]` resolves at agent_class, `[zone, bucket]` at zone, `[class, tenant]` at sla_class and tenant. Every such assignment is marked `rangeSource`/`scopeSource` = "implementation". §8.10's "Source of truth" column is recorded as `owner`; its "Class" column is the §22.3 change class, with "Tuning" normalised to TUNED.

parameters.name: cost.reference_agent_class
parameters.awaits: the fleet's agent-class taxonomy (Phase 2)
parameters.description: The reference agent class whose one second of fully-loaded committed time defines 1 CU. Every other cost is priced against it.

parameters.name: cost.cu_per_currency_unit
parameters.awaits: the fully-loaded cost of one reference-agent second from finance
parameters.description: The single rate converting CU to money. Decision records carry both views: operators and finance reason in currency, the engine in CU.

parameters.name: cost.lambda_time
parameters.awaits: per-class fully-loaded operating cost
parameters.description: Marginal value of one second of an agent's committed time. 1.0 for the reference class by construction of the CU.

parameters.name: cost.lambda_time_floor
parameters.awaits: the minimum per-class lambda_time once classes are calibrated
parameters.constraint: ≤ min over agent classes of cost.lambda_time
parameters.description: λ_min — the configured floor on the marginal value of agent time. Required to be a genuine underestimate: the admissibility of the candidate-pruning lower bound depends on it.

parameters.name: cost.energy.cu_per_wh
parameters.awaits: the energy tariff; derived, not chosen
parameters.description: Exchange rate pricing consumed energy in CU. Derived from the tariff — a dimensioned rate traceable to an accounting figure, never a tuning knob.

parameters.name: cost.wear.cu_per_metre
parameters.awaits: maintenance cost over rated distance per class
parameters.description: Distance-proportional wear, priced from replacement cost over rated life.

parameters.name: cost.battery.cu_per_equivalent_cycle
parameters.awaits: pack replacement cost and rated cycle count per class
parameters.description: Battery wear priced per equivalent full cycle.

parameters.name: cost.failure.cu
parameters.awaits: measured recovery expense by mission class and custody state
parameters.description: Expected cost of a failure, keyed by mission class and custody state. A failure while holding custody is a different event from one before pickup.

parameters.name: cost.energy_consequence
parameters.awaits: measured cost of a charge diversion, a recovery mission, and an in-service immobilisation
parameters.description: Consequence cost of each energy shortfall tier — one value per §14.5 tier. These are not the same event and must not share a price.

parameters.name: cost.sla.cu_per_second_late
parameters.awaits: contract terms and remediation cost per tenant
parameters.description: Lateness priced per second, from contract terms — not a tuning weight.

parameters.name: cost.sla.breach_penalty
parameters.awaits: contractual breach penalties
parameters.description: M_breach — the step cost incurred when the SLA deadline is crossed, carried by exactly one terminal Leg.

parameters.name: cost.sla.lateness_exponent
parameters.awaits: an ops decision on how superlinearly lateness should be penalised
parameters.description: Exponent on lateness. Dimensionless by construction — it shapes a priced quantity, it does not price one.

parameters.name: cost.sla.upstream_slack_weight
parameters.awaits: observed multi-Leg delay propagation
parameters.description: Share of a Mission's delay cost attributed to upstream Legs as slack consumption. The terminal Leg carries the full term and M_breach; upstream Legs carry only this.

parameters.name: cost.aging.reference_period
parameters.awaits: observed queue-age distribution
parameters.description: Reference age at which the aging multiplier reaches its nominal growth.

parameters.name: cost.aging.growth_exponent
parameters.awaits: observed starvation patterns in shadow mode
parameters.description: How fast the aging multiplier grows with queue age.

parameters.name: cost.aging.max_multiplier
parameters.awaits: an ops decision bounded by requirement
parameters.constraint: finite — an unbounded value is rejected at publish, not merely discouraged
parameters.description: Ceiling on the aging multiplier. Bounded by requirement: anti-starvation is guaranteed by the §17.4 escalation ladder, not by letting this term grow without limit.

parameters.name: cost.opportunity.lambda_zone_prior
parameters.awaits: operating data; static configured priors are the degraded path and the Tier 2 kill-switch fallback
parameters.description: λ_zone — the single primitive of the opportunity term: the availability value density of a zone in a time bucket.

parameters.name: cost.opportunity.value_horizon
parameters.awaits: measured mission-duration and commitment-horizon distributions
parameters.description: T_H — the horizon over which an agent's availability is valued. Validated at publish to exceed the commitment horizon plus the region's maximum admissible mission duration, else the opportunity term silently saturates.

parameters.name: cost.opportunity.max_terminal_gain

derivation.formula: Ω_terminal = (max λ_zone − min λ_zone over the region) · cost.opportunity.value_horizon + max_charge_access_gain(region) + max_soc_deficit_gain(class)
derivation.computedBy: Capacity Pricing Service, per round, published alongside the price snapshot
derivation.phase: Not computed in Phase 1: it is derived per round from the round's price snapshot, which arrives with the pricing client. Phase 1 registers it, records its derivation, and refuses a hand-entered value.

parameters.description: Ω_terminal — the largest terminal-value gain any relocation within the region could produce. Bounds the negative part of C_opportunity so the candidate-pruning lower bound stays admissible.

parameters.name: cost.uncertainty_penalty
parameters.awaits: per-predicate indeterminate rates and their realised consequences
parameters.description: Cost added when a non-safety predicate evaluates INDETERMINATE and the candidate is admitted under uncertainty. Class I and R predicates DENY instead and are never priced.

parameters.name: cost.staleness.cu_per_second_age
parameters.awaits: measured relationship between observation age and realised error
parameters.description: Price of reasoning from an aged observation, per second of age.

parameters.name: churn.base_cost
parameters.awaits: measured cost of a reassignment; churn pricing is Tier 2 and ships disabled
parameters.description: Fixed hysteresis cost of revising an existing assignment in the rolling horizon. Non-negative always.

parameters.name: churn.per_second_elapsed
parameters.awaits: measured sunk progress cost; churn pricing is Tier 2 and ships disabled
parameters.description: Additional churn cost per second of progress already made against the assignment being revised.

parameters.name: policy.max_zone_affinity_credit
parameters.awaits: an ops decision on how much local knowledge and permit familiarity are worth
parameters.description: Ceiling on the zone-affinity credit — the baseline's zone-locality preference, now priced in CU rather than applied as a 0.05 additive constant. Placeholder ≈ one minute of reference-agent time.

parameters.name: policy.max_dedicated_fleet_credit
parameters.awaits: the dedicated-fleet contract terms
parameters.description: Ceiling on the credit steering a tenant's contractually dedicated agents to that tenant's work.

parameters.name: policy.max_burn_in_credit
parameters.awaits: an ops decision on probation-window steering strength
parameters.description: Ceiling on the training/burn-in credit directing new agents or new firmware to low-risk work during a probation window.

parameters.name: policy.max_pilot_adjustment
parameters.awaits: the first controlled trial's design
parameters.description: Ceiling on scoped, expiring pilot adjustments. The adjustment itself must carry an expiry and is refused once it has passed.

parameters.name: policy.max_operator_adjustment
parameters.awaits: an ops-leadership decision on override strength
parameters.description: Ceiling on an authorised, reasoned, audited operator nudge — bounded so it can influence choice among feasible agents but never dominate the objective.

parameters.name: cost.policy.max_total_credit

derivation.formula: Ω_policy = Σ (credit ceiling of every C_policy adjustment)

parameters.description: Ω_policy — computed at publish, never hand-maintained, and republished whenever any constituent ceiling changes. Introducing a new policy adjustment therefore updates the pruning bound as a mechanical consequence of registering it.
